video_title: John Wall Says It's Time For Boston To Move On From Jaylen Brown

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall argues Boston should move on from Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I think his comments from this year when he came out and was like, 'This is my favorite year of all.' That's when they realized we got to move on for JB.
quotes.quote: I feel like it is that time. I love him and Jason Tatum together, they won a championship. You always get these conversations when you have two guys that think they are 1A. It is always difficult and when you let the media get involved or the outside noise get involved, it can mess up a team. I think when he won Finals MVP, it kind of shook a lot of people up. I think his comments from this year when he came out and was like, 'This is my favorite year of all.' Why would you say that? Your best year, I get it, you had career numbers, you had the number one option, but your best career got to be winning Finals MVP and winning a championship in a season. That should have been your best year. So I think from that point forward at the end of the season, when he made that comment about this is my best year, that is when they realized we got to move on for JB. JB wants his own team, JB needs his own team.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Jaylen Brown's comments and Boston's perspective
quotes.excerpt: I can easily see how he is saying from a perspective, this was his favorite season.
quotes.quote: The comments were taken the way they were taken. I do not know JB like that to know truly what he was thinking or how he meant that. Sometimes somebody could say something and I can easily see how he is saying from a perspective, this was his favorite season where he felt like he led a team for a change and he did not have to play second fiddle. You can understand that as a player from that standpoint. But he has to understand that those when you say it like that, it is going to come off a certain way to the public. It feels like to me in this situation that with Brian Windhorst saying that even if he is not in the Giannis trade, they are going to move him anyway, that Boston has interpreted that as, okay, it is time to do something about this because we do not like the direction that we see this going in.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the negative impact of podcasts on team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I am still a firm and a strong believer of that podcasting and streaming while you are playing can fuck up relationships.
quotes.quote: I am still a firm and a strong believer of that podcasting and streaming while you are playing can fuck up relationships and fuck up a locker room and fuck up things for you. Especially if you are doing it while the season is going. Because it is a trust factor there. I cannot walk into a film room and feel comfortable that we are about to have a film session, knowing that somebody I am teammates with, somebody in this film room, they are about to go do a podcast and they are about to go do a stream. I do not know what they are going to say. Now, Draymond Green is a little bit more experienced, but I guarantee you, if he went and had a conversation with Joe Lacob and Steve Kerr and he asked them their true feelings, I am pretty sure they would say, 'Hey Draymond, can you dial back just a little bit?' I know the locker rooms I was in, we were zero tolerance for some shit like that. We would have been calling you the police, the feds, all type of shit.

quotes.speaker: John Wall
quotes.summary_phrase: John Wall on Jaylen Brown's desire for his own team
quotes.excerpt: JB is letting it know like, listen here, I need my own show. I need my own show.
quotes.quote: JB is letting it know like, listen here, I need my own show. I need my own show. And that is what he wants. And if it was not him getting on this podcast or having his streaming app, whatever, and this does not ever come out, we all just going to say, oh they do not get along. We are just going to say that behind closed doors because we do not know the truth. He is on his streaming platform or podcast saying certain things that is throwing hints out there to be like, oh this and that. It is the same situation for me and Bradley Beal. Everybody like, man, me and Bradley Beal, we did not have the best relationship off the court. We did not hang out a lot. But when we stepped between those four lines, we knew we competing. We want to win. But then you get to the point of if you listen to the outside noise, everybody like, oh they need to break that up, they do not like each other. I do not have to be best friends with you off the court. Long as I can compete and do what I need to do between these four lines to feed my family and make sure this team got a chance to win every night, we are fine. JB is letting it know like, listen here, I need my own show. I need my own show. And that is what he wants.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Boston's unique knowledge of their players
quotes.excerpt: No other team is more privy to what they know of Jayson Tatum or Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: No other team is more privy to what they know of Jayson Tatum or Jaylen Brown. They have been with them there, they have both been in Boston their whole career. And so for them to come to this point now, like you say, I feel like this whole scenario, who knows if this is the situation if he does not, if he refrains from those comments. But like you said, those things are out there and now we are left to interpret it however because it was not, he did not say like, I want my own team. But like you said, what he said could be interpreted by certain people that that is what he meant by that. Because why would he not say that his year winning MVP and of the finals and winning a championship. Like people are going to question that because they do not understand what he meant by that or how he how he thinks.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the impact of injury on player mental health
quotes.excerpt: When you are sidelined with an injury like that, man, you go through depression, man, as an athlete.
quotes.quote: When you are sidelined with an injury like that, man, you go through depression, man, as an athlete. You are fucking depressed and especially when your team is thriving and having success without you. And so it would have fucked me up to hear Rondo or somebody say, oh yeah man, we had the best season of our career, man, you know what I am saying. And here I am, Perk, man, I was out, dog. I am supposed to be part of your big five. Like, I won a championship with you, you know what I am saying. We ain't lose a series when I started five was healthy. Imagine how Jaylen Brown was feeling.
